process.headline: How we work together
process.intro: A clear, six-step path from first conversation to keys in hand.

steps.title: Selecting a property
steps.description: Define your goals, then match you with vetted opportunities that fit your strategy and risk profile.

steps.title: Sales & Purchase Agreement
steps.description: Negotiate terms, review the SPA, and ensure every clause works in your favour before signing.

steps.title: Initial deposit
steps.description: Coordinate the secure transfer of funds in line with developer or seller schedules.

steps.title: Obtaining approvals
steps.description: Manage NOCs, mortgage approvals (where applicable), and any developer or authority sign-offs.

steps.title: Completing payments
steps.description: Track instalments, oversee escrow releases, and keep every milestone on schedule.

steps.title: Dubai Land Department registration
steps.description: Finalise the title transfer with the DLD and hand over your new property and ownership documents.
